reason: I already drive down to Jbeil on Saturdays and do my big shop myself, following the Tawfeer and supermarket offers. I would still have to collect the bag at their hour, so I would not save much.
objection: I would still have to go and collect it, at their hour, not mine, and I pay a fee on top for it. I also can't check what they paid at the till, and I would rather choose the deals myself.
would_change_my_mind: Home delivery, or a pickup point on my own street. Or a receipt photo with every bag, and the fee dropped when I order a big stock-up.
